spans.s:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Disregarding, neglecting, disdaining.
2 Patient, enduring.
E.
उप before ईक्ष to see, वुन् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Leaving, abandoning.
5 Disregarding, neglecting, disdaining.
E.
उप and ईक्षण seeing.

f. (-क्षा)
1 Trick, deceit, one of the minor expedients in war.
2 Abandoning, leaving.
3

Negligence, neglect.
5 Endurance, patience.
6 Contempt, disdain.
E.
उप, ईक्ष to see, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Disregarded, disesteemed, neglected, disdained.
E.
उप, and ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Endowed with, possessed of, having, possessing.
2 Arrived at, come to, come near to.
3 Invested.
E.
उप and इत gone.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
1 Contriving, a contriver, one who employs expedients.
2 Approaching, going near to.
E.
उप before इण to go, तृच् aff.

m. (-न्द्रः)
A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA.
E.
उप after, इन्द्र INDRA: born subsequently to INDRA.

f. (-ज्रा)
A species of the Triṣṭubh metre.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be sought, to be had recourse to.
2 To be gone to or approached.
3 To be effected by any means.
E.
उप before इण to go, यत् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-युषी-वत्)
1 Accompanied or followed by, associated with, united.
2 Obtained, got.
E.
उप near, इण to go, क्वसु aff.

mfn. (-यूः-यूः-युः)
Arrived at, gone to.
E.
उप before इण to go, उस् aff.
